highlights.title: Why Huawei’s New Chipmaking Plan Has Investors Buzzing
highlights.description: The artificial intelligence boom has triggered an insatiable demand for computing power, with companies such as Amazon.com Inc., Meta Platforms Inc. and Microsoft Corp. pouring hundreds of billions of dollars into data centers and advanced chips developed by US semiconductor giant Nvidia Corp.

highlights.title: SpaceX Investor Powerlaw to Debut on Nasdaq as IPO Race Heats Up
highlights.description: Powerlaw Corp., a closed-end fund that owns stakes in Elon Musk’s SpaceX and artificial intelligence firm OpenAI, is going public without raising any capital in the latest public vehicle to cater to retail investors’ clamor for exposure to the hottest private tech companies.

highlights.title: Memory Chip Frenzy Sends SK Hynix, Micron Into $1 Trillion Club
highlights.description: The breakneck surge in memory-chip stocks is intensifying, sending the market capitalizations of SK Hynix Inc. and Micron Technology Inc. above $1 trillion for the first time, as investors bet the AI boom will lead to a sustained revaluation of the industry.

highlights.title: ByteDance Weighs Capex of as Much as $70 Billion in AI Push
highlights.description: ByteDance Ltd., the developer of TikTok and a leading force in artificial intelligence, is considering increasing its capital spending to more than double last year’s in a bid to lead the Chinese AI market and challenge the top US players abroad.

highlights.title: Did the Pope use AI to write about the dangers of AI?
highlights.description: It's possible that AI was used to write parts of Pope Leo XIV's latest encyclical about AI's impact on humanity. An analysis by Linch Zhang posted on the forum LessWrong found certain paragraphs of Magnifica Humanitas to be between 40 percent and 100 percent written by AI, according to the popular AI detector Pangram. highlights.title: Germany, Spain Push Back on European Plan to Ban Huawei Gear
highlights.description: Germany and Spain are leading opposition to European Commission plans to ban Chinese technology suppliers from telecom networks as part of new cybersecurity rules, according to people familiar with the negotiations.

highlights.title: Salesforce Earnings Can Put AI Fears to Bed, Give Stock a Lift
highlights.description: While software stocks rebound from the artificial intelligence-driven wipeout earlier this year, Salesforce Inc. hasn’t really benefited. But its earnings after the close Wednesday could pull the company’s shares out of their malaise.

highlights.title: SK Hynix hits $1 trillion valuation as AI boom lifts South Korean chip stocks
highlights.description: Shares of SK Hynix soared over 11% on Wednesday, pushing the South Korean memory-chip maker above the $1 trillion market capitalization mark.

chips_cloud.title: Taiwan Suspects Nvidia AI Chip Shipment Smuggled to China
chips_cloud.description: Taiwan prosecutors suspect three individuals successfully smuggled at least one shipment of Nvidia AI chips to China after first exporting them to Japan, people familiar with the matter said. The trio was detained for allegedly falsifying documents related to exports of Super Micro Computer servers containing advanced Nvidia chips, which the US has barred from sale to China without a license. Bloomberg Intelligence's Matthew Bloxham breaks down the situation. (Source: Bloomberg)

chips_cloud.description: Memory chip maker ChangXin Memory Technologies Inc. has received approval from the Shanghai Stock Exchange for an initial public offering that’s on track to be the biggest in mainland China since 2022, in a milestone for one of the key technologies of the artificial intelligence buildout.
